title: Great practice
content: I’ve been a patient here for over 20 years and  have had really good care. The GPs, nurses, reception team and admin staff are kind, efficient and helpful. Reception staff, despite being under pressure at the front desk, are especially friendly and caring. Thank you so much.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
